**Risk flags**
- Defendant in 8 case(s), total claims RM3,112,600  
- Single shareholder holds 87.78%

**Overview**  
Everbright Prima Homestay Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited boutique hotel operating in Penang, incorporated on 12 December 2013 and registered in Selangor. The company has five directors and a dominant shareholder owning 87.78% of the equity. Reported revenues are RM30,841,056; RM42,064,722; and RM59,059,072 across three reporting periods, with equity of RM13,873,412; RM15,828,220; and RM18,634,176 respectively. Net profit, audit opinion and current ratio are not disclosed.
